title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 current SGA working record: SGA 6 complete and SGA 7-I complete through source page 528
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record keeps the current reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and compact source ZIPs for SGA translation/reconstruction work.

Status at a glance. SGA 5 high-fidelity source-checked stream is complete through printed page 484. SGA 6 French/English stream is structurally covered through source pages 001-702, including terminological and notation indexes at source pages 693-702, but the 2026-06-08 audit identifies localized compression/omission gaps and it is not yet scribe-grade complete. SGA 7-I source-checked English/French working edition is complete through source page 528. The existing SGA 3 English translation has been rebuilt to remove raw code-block typography, but is not yet a full mathematical re-typeset.

2026-06-08 SGA6 audit caveat. SGA6 is structurally represented across source pages 001-702, but the current cumulative French/English TeX/PDF should be treated as a substantial working draft rather than a scribe-grade complete edition. The nuclear audit found localized substantive compression/omission candidates, with confirmed/strong samples on source pages 014, 431, 625, and 679. The next repair targets are p014, then clusters 423-454, 619-653, and 670-692. The page-range chain is not missing a whole payload; the damage profile is local compression and omission in specific prose/math blocks.

Latest update. Adds source-checked English/French SGA 7-I cumulative readers through source page 528, the matching complete source-scan witness for SGA 7-I, and the SGA 7-I p505-528 source packet. This pass covers the Expose IX conclusion, Section 13.5, Section 14, and bibliography, completing the SGA 7-I scan in this intake. The next anchor is SGA 7-II source scan intake.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub repository issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: SGA satellite record. Current SGA6 material is structurally covered but not scribe-grade complete; see the 2026-06-08 nuclear audit packet and repair queue for localized compression gaps.
